gloss: grazing; pasturing; putting out to pasture

definitions.gloss: grazing; pasturing; putting livestock out to pasture
definitions.explanation: The practice of letting livestock roam and feed freely on open land.

examples.japanese: {牛|うし}を{放牧|ほうぼく}する。
examples.english: To put cattle out to pasture.

examples.japanese: {広|ひろ}い{草原|そうげん}で{羊|ひつじ}が{放牧|ほうぼく}されている。
examples.english: Sheep are grazing on the wide grassland.

examples.japanese: この{牧場|ぼくじょう}では{放牧|ほうぼく}で{育|そだ}てた{牛|うし}の{乳|ちち}から{作|つく}ったチーズが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: This ranch is known for cheese made from the milk of pasture-raised cattle.

notes:
Composed of {放|ほう} (release, let go) + {牧|ぼく} (herding, pasture). Describes the agricultural practice of free-range grazing as opposed to keeping animals in enclosed spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放牧|ほうぼく}{地|ち} (pasture land, grazing land)
- {放牧|ほうぼく}で{育|そだ}てる (raise by free-range grazing)
- {自然|しぜん}{放牧|ほうぼく} (natural grazing)
- {放牧|ほうぼく}{期間|きかん} (grazing period/season)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {牧畜|ぼくちく} — livestock farming (the broader industry of raising animals)
- {飼育|しいく} — raising, breeding (keeping and caring for animals, not necessarily free-range)
- {遊牧|ゆうぼく} — nomadic herding (moving with livestock across regions)
